真不怪老鸨反应这么大。
毕竟，齐知玄肉眼可见的成长了。
当然。
厨房里其他人没有这样突兀的感觉。
齐知玄每天在他们眼皮底下晃悠，每天长胖一点点，很正常。
厨子嘛，谁不是脑袋大脖子粗？
领完工资，齐知玄攥着手里的两千五百泥钞，瞥了眼常昆那四个壮汉。
“打麻将要输给他们五百，实际到手只有两千。”
齐知玄心中盘算着收入，心想：“两千泥钞能够买到不少补药，暂时够用，但拜师学武的钱就……”
学武的话，每个月至少要花费三千泥钞。
只有中上收入群体能够支撑得起这么大的开销。
“我必须每个月收入四千甚至五千泥钞，才有机会习武。”
正分析着。
外面又双叒传来一阵号丧。
“欸，刘二的家属又来闹事了。”
众人伸头探脑，表情玩味。
刘二被赵家做成花肥，他的家人面对赵家自然是敢怒不敢言。
可是，不知是谁偷偷告诉了刘二的家人一些事。
刘二的家人这才知道，刘二之所以被杀，竟是尹大峰和老何害的，老鸨也脱不了干系。

一时间。
刘二的爹娘，媳妇和三岁的儿子，还有两个弟弟一个小妹，一大家子全部怒了。
怨恨彻底爆发！
他们是惹不起赵家，但还对付不了一个老鸨，一个厨子和一个砧板工吗？
于是，他们白天堵门，晚上堵门，使劲闹腾。
尹大峰和老何被搞得灰头土脸，躲在媚香楼里，两天没敢回家。
“?你娘比的，当媚香楼是什么地方？”
老鸨脸都黑了。
她已经向刘二的家人解释过了，还送了他们一笔安葬费。
哪想到，这家人仍是死缠烂打。
“不识抬举！”
老鸨一个眼神，常昆四人立刻心领神会，他们冲出去，蛮狠驱赶刘二那一家子。
刘二家人跟常昆斗智斗勇，先是离开，过一会再次折返回来，接着骂，骂的可难听了。
“老板娘，要不要上点手段？”常昆眼神凶恶，做出了一个握拳的手势。
老鸨面沉如水，厉声道：“一群不知死活的东西！给老娘好好教训他们，让他们知道怕字怎么写。”
常昆狰狞一笑，掠身冲出，好似一阵旋风，抓住刘二的老父亲，将他高高举起，如同破麻袋一样重重摔在地上。
“哇！”
刘二老父亲当场吐血，身上骨头不知断了多少根。
太惨了！

I really can’t blame the madam for having such a big reaction.
After all, Qi Zhixuan has grown up visibly to the naked eye.
certainly.
No one else in the kitchen felt this abrupt.
Qi Zhixuan hangs out under their noses every day and gains a little weight every day, which is normal.
As for cooks, who doesn’t have a big head and a thick neck?
After receiving his salary, Qi Zhixuan clutched the two thousand five hundred yuan notes in his hand and glanced at Chang Kun's four strong men.
"I lost 500 to them in mahjong, but I only got 2000."
Qi Zhixuan calculated his income in his mind and thought: "Two thousand cash can buy a lot of tonics, which is enough for the time being, but the money to learn martial arts from a master is..."
If you want to learn martial arts, you will need to spend at least 3,000 yuan per month.
Only the middle- and upper-income groups can afford such a large expense.
"I have to earn 4,000 or even 5,000 yuan a month to have the opportunity to practice martial arts."
Analyzing.
There was another mourning call outside.
"Hey, Liu Er's family members are making trouble again."
Everyone stretched their heads and looked at each other with playful expressions.
Liu Er was made into flower fertilizer by the Zhao family, and his family naturally dared not speak out in front of the Zhao family.
However, I don’t know who secretly told Liu Er’s family something.
Only then did Liu Er's family know that the reason why Liu Er was killed was actually caused by Yin Dafeng and Lao He, and the old bustard was also involved.
For a while.
Liu Er's parents, daughter-in-law, three-year-old son, two brothers and a little sister were all angry.
Resentment completely broke out!
They can't afford to offend the Zhao family, but they can't deal with a madam, a cook and a chopping board worker?
So they blocked the door during the day and blocked the door at night, making a lot of noise.
Yin Dafeng and Lao He were so disgraced that they hid in Meixiang Building and did not dare to go home for two days.
"What kind of place is Meixiang Building?"
The madam's face turned dark.
She had already explained it to Liu Er's family and gave them a burial fee.
Unexpectedly, this family is still obsessed with each other.
"I don't know how to praise!"
With the look from the old bustard, Chang Kun and the others immediately understood. They rushed out and drove Liu Er's family away ruthlessly.
Liu Er's family battled wits with Chang Kun. They left first, then came back again after a while, and then scolded them, and the scolding was quite unpleasant.
"Boss Boss, do you want to do something?" Chang Kun's eyes were fierce and he made a fist gesture.
The old bustard's face was as dark as water, and he said sternly: "A bunch of people who don't know how to live or die! Give them a lesson, let me teach them how to write the word fear."
Chang Kun smiled ferociously, rushed out like a whirlwind, grabbed Liu Er's old father, lifted him high, and threw him to the ground like a broken sack.
"Wow!"
Father Liu Er vomited blood on the spot and had countless broken bones in his body.
Too bad!
